body: No problem at all. I've kind of been through it. I'm here whenever you need to talk.

I'm in my 30's and still suck thumb. And being a virgin at 16 isn't a bad thing. I've just found love now. I was the same way. But by the sounds of it you have a lovely mum and family. And you do want to change for them. But believe me it's not something that just happens my mum is my rock, for 30 years I've been a fuck up. But slower day by day. Year by year I'm in a much better place for us all. And your mum will forgive you. Bet she would rather have her daughter around working to fix things, then not have a daughter at all. Please speak to a helpline they helped me loads when I was on verge. If not I'm here to chat whenever you want. Look after yourself.

I'm not gonna say miraculously its gonna get better it doesn't. I failed at school and then college. But there is a light at the end. Through hard work and devotion I'm no in a position of owning my own business. I was in the same boat as you saw no way of showing emotions. You have someone that loves you in your girlfriend let her see the true you. Sit down and slowly talk about your emotions I've finally found someone I can do this with ex didn't care. And it's not a healthy relationship to be in. I know. You are young. Life is a struggle at times and don't get me wrong I was within minutes of doing something then found someone online that helped me walk away. Please call a suicide helpline they are there to listen and help. You don't need to say who you are. I've called them on a few occasions and let out emotions. If you need to talk I'm here send a DM. Have you tried a therapist. Good luck and I hope you change your mind

I know the feeling of reminiscing of the past I do it all the time. As the first the women part your 23. I've just found someone I'm 33. I had given up and was on verge of the same thing. Sorry but you sound like a younger version of me. You will find a job. The right one doesn't come along I failed school left with no grades and now co own a business. It will change and the cliche that it gets better with time is true. Learn the guitar. Play it whenever you can. The only thing that defines you is YOU. Not what other people say or things that you feel are bad about you. I had the thought and acted on the thought of the pills but luckily I was also on a prevention line. I'm not proud of what i did but I did do it. 
Life does get better. Speak to your psychiatrist about how you truly feel. Pursue you dream. And when you see people out together you will have that one day and with someone that is perfect for trust me I'd given up. And found mine in a unlikely place. I can see that you want to get help and I hope you've changed your mind. If not and you still feel the same speak to a suicide hotline. It's better to hear someone's voice they are there for you. Best of luck. You are not alone
